title: EU lawmakers urge foreign policy chief to 'end complicity in genocide' against Palestinians
content: 'After 789 days of genocide and 58 years of illegal occupation... Europe cannot continue to be complicit,' MEPs say in letter to Kaja Kallas

title: Several Palestinians wounded as Israel shells northern Gaza's Beit Lahia
content: Israeli army continues to hold southern, eastern, much of northern Gaza – spanning more than half of enclave's total area

title: Palestinian rights group warns Israel plotting to assassinate jailed Palestinian leader Barghouti
content: Barghouti’s son says Israeli forces ‘crushed his father’s body, broke his teeth, ribs, and fingers, and cut part of his ear inside prison

title: 1 year after revolution, Syria turns to investment – not aid – for reconstruction
content: Officials and analysts say Syria is shifting from an ‘aid mindset’ to an ‘investment mindset’ as foreign capital and major regional deals gain momentum

title: Brutal West Bank assault: Palestinian man recalls being beaten, dragged and left unconscious by illegal Israeli settlers
content: ‘They hit me with rifle butts, stoned me, and dragged me until I lost consciousness’ says Owais Hammam

title: China pledges $100M in aid to Palestine to help alleviate humanitarian crisis in Gaza
content: President Xi Jinping announces fresh aid, as French President Emmanuel Macron concludes 3-day state visit to China

title: Germany urges Israel to stop settlement construction in West Bank ahead of Merz-Netanyahu meeting
content: ‘We reject any steps aimed at annexing the West Bank. We see this as a significant obstacle on the path to ... peace plan,’ says spokesman

title: Israeli army kills 1 Palestinian, injures 4 in occupied West Bank attacks
content: Health officials say 38-year-old died after being shot in head during clashes in Odala village in south of Nablus

title: Over 100 Sundanese families held by RSF in dire conditions in West Kordofan, say medics
content: Sudan Doctors Network says Rapid Support Forces are holding more than 100 families, including women, children, and pregnant women, in life-threatening conditions in Babnousa

title: Syrian Central Bank inks agreement with Visa for digital payment system
content: Main goal of agreement is building secure payments infrastructure with authorized financial institutions, SANA reports

title: Lebanese president meets UN delegation in Beirut, calls for pressing Israel to enforce ceasefire
content: Joseph Aoun tells visiting UN Security Council envoys that Lebanon remains committed to international resolutions but needs international pressure to ensure Israeli compliance

title: Riyadh forum pushes global transparency and digital transformation in non-profit sector
content: Event brings together leading international experts to discuss how technology, international coordination can improve data reliability across sector

title: Turkish defense giant Aselsan opens representative office in Egypt
content: New chapter to serve Egyptian Armed Forces, other Egypt-based clients directly, says general manager

title: Illegal Israeli settlers torch Palestinian vehicles, cut water lines in West Bank attacks
content: Attackers carried out 2 overnight raids in occupied territory, burning cars in village east of Ramallah and severing water lines in northern Jordan Valley hamlet

title: Israeli forces carry out new incursion in Syria’s Quneitra countryside
content: Israeli vehicles advanced toward villages of Saida al-Hanout, Beer Ajam, Bariqa, reports official media
